stories.name: context-window-resolution
stories.title: Context Window Resolution
stories.description: Resolve each conversation's effective context window and fill from backend-reported facts without setting num_ctx. Adds POST /models/runtime (GET /api/ps, never loads a model), fetchModelRuntime, the pure resolveContextWindow/computeContextFill in src/lib/context-window.ts, the remembered per-provider/model runtime window persisted with the sidebar preferences, stream_options.include_usage on OpenAI-compatible streams, and chat.send validation of contextWindow/contextWindowSource/modelFamily.

includes: src/lib/context-window.ts: resolveContextWindow and computeContextFill (pure)
server/index.ts, server/llm-router.ts runtimeInfo, server/ollama-client.ts /api/ps fetch: POST /models/runtime
src/lib/ollama.ts: fetchModelRuntime
src/lib/chat.ts, src/lib/use-sidebar-state.ts: remembered runtime window per provider/model, persisted
server/openai-client.ts: stream_options.include_usage
server/request-validation.ts and wire types: optional chat.send fields contextWindow, contextWindowSource, modelFamily (accepted and validated only; server does not act on them yet)
buildOllamaChatBody regression test: no options.num_ctx
shared/context-usage.ts: contextPercent only (shared arithmetic used by computeContextFill)
excludes: use of contextWindow/modelFamily by the server (S4)
note builder, placement data and applyContextPlacement in shared/context-usage.ts (S3/S4); S1 adds only contextPercent

stories.notes: Primary owning_module is context-window (src/lib/context-window.ts is the behavioural core: AC-CTX-1..4, 8). The story also adds small supporting edits in runtime-route, backend-http-client, sidebar-prefs, provider-clients and wire-types (validation of three optional chat.send fields); each is wiring for the one capability 'know the window' and none re-creates logic another module owns. Depends on: none. Defines seams S-WINDOW and S-RUNTIME. computeContextFill needs the rounded percentage: contextPercent lives in shared/context-usage.ts, whose file S3 creates; to keep S1 free of an S3 dependency, S1 creates shared/context-usage.ts with contextPercent only (arithmetic seam owned by the context-usage module) and S3 / S4 extend that file.

stories.name: context-meter
stories.title: Context Meter
stories.description: Toggleable frontend context meter bound to the showContextMeter sidebar preference (off by default, persisted). Renders token count and percentage with en-US grouping via contextPercent, a progress bar with data-level ok/warn/error (80/100 percent), an em dash for unknown fill, 0 for none-yet, labels for estimated/assumed/stale windows, and re-queries /models/runtime after each chat.done.

includes: src/components/context-meter.tsx (new, presentational) wired from the composition root or a hook it calls
showContextMeter in SidebarState (src/lib/chat.ts, src/lib/use-sidebar-state.ts) and a settings preference row
post-chat.done runtime refresh feeding resolveContextWindow
theme tokens for ok/warn/error levels

stories.notes: Depends on: S1 (resolveContextWindow, computeContextFill, fetchModelRuntime, contextPercent). Consumes seam S-WINDOW. Owns AC-STRUCT-2 because it is the story that introduces showContextMeter and so completes the 'no meter logic under server/' grep; the export half of AC-STRUCT-2 is delivered by S1 and re-verified here. Must land in the panes/hooks structure from epic-frontend-architecture-maintainability, not inline in chat-workspace.tsx.

stories.name: placement-research
stories.title: Placement Research
stories.description: Research story: establish how a usage note and a compaction summary are best placed in a model's context, per model family, on a live Ollama. Produces docs/research/compaction-placement.md (Method, Candidates, Findings, Decision) and mirrors the Decision table as placement data (default note placement, default summary placement, per-family exceptions) exported by shared/context-usage.ts, with a unit test asserting the data equals the parsed Decision table. Delivers the default early so S4-S6 are not blocked on exhaustive per-family testing.

includes: docs/research/compaction-placement.md with Method naming the Ollama version and instrument (OLLAMA_DEBUG runner logs, prompt_eval_duration deltas)

Findings: row per candidate for at least three families including qwen3 (default test model qwen3:1.7b), and the prompt_eval_count reported for a prompt longer than the loaded window; Decision states the meaning of the meter error band
placement data export in shared/context-usage.ts (default + exceptions) and the document-parsing unit test
MV-1 manual validation of the Findings (owner Markus, blocked on AC-RES-3, adjudicated 2026-10-02)
excludes: any production code path consuming the placement data

stories.notes: Research story; MV-1 is a manual-validation row, not an AC ID, so it is recorded here rather than in acceptance_criteria (schema requires AC-<TAG>-<N>). Depends on: none. Requires a live Ollama at OLLAMA_URL=http://host.lima.internal:11434/api (verified reachable via /api/tags at planning time). Locally pulled families usable as findings rows: qwen3 (qwen3:1.7b, default test model), qwen2 (qwen2.5:3b-instruct), llama (llama3.2:1b), gemma3 (gemma3:4b), gemma4 (gemma4:12b), qwen35, gptoss (gpt-oss:20b); candidates: at least qwen3, llama, gemma3 and one more. shared/context-usage.ts already exists after S1 (contextPercent); S3 adds only the placement data export and keeps the file's other exports untouched. creates_seam: placement data shape consumed by S4 (S-PLACEMENT).

stories.name: context-usage-note
stories.title: Context-Usage Note
stories.description: Shared note builder and placement transform, injected on every model invocation while compact_context is enabled. Adds buildContextUsageNote and applyContextPlacement (returns a new array; always called, also maps compaction steps onto wire steps) to shared/context-usage.ts, makes the tool loop in server/ws-handler.ts send the placed per-invocation copy with a note built from the previous invocation's usage (first invocation from incoming steps), carries the new chat.send fields through backend-client and chat-workspace, and applies the same transform in the request JSON preview, toOllamaFilteredMessages and useReconciliation. The note is never rendered or persisted as a step.

includes: shared/context-usage.ts: buildContextUsageNote (fixed en-US), applyContextPlacement(steps,{note?,family?})
server/ws-handler.ts: per-invocation placement, note from previous invocation usage, gated on compact_context being enabled
src/lib/backend-client.ts and composition root: send contextWindow, contextWindowSource, modelFamily
src/components/request-json-dialog.tsx, src/lib/token-view.ts toOllamaFilteredMessages and useReconciliation, request-preview-extras.tsx: same transform with note rebuilt from steps before the target
excludes: compact_context executor, interception and sole-call rule (S5)
StepKind 'compaction' type additions (S6); S4's transform treats kind structurally via FormatStep

stories.notes: Depends on: S1 (chat.send fields, resolved window), S3 (placement data). Consumes seams S-WINDOW and S-PLACEMENT; creates the applyContextPlacement/buildContextUsageNote API consumed by S5, S6. Primary owning_module is context-usage; the ws-handler edit here is limited to placement and note injection, the tool-loop interception belongs to S5. Because compact_context is not registered until S5, S4 tests use a fake enabled tool id 'compact_context' in the request's tools via the mocked provider (a permanent test fixture, not a mock of production code).

stories.name: compact-context-tool
stories.title: compact_context Tool
stories.description: Built-in server tool compact_context({summary, remaining_work?}) registered in both the static dispatcher behind GET /tools and each connection's dispatcher with one stable id. The tool loop intercepts it: a valid sole call records tool_call and tool_result steps and ends the turn with chat.done carrying compaction {toolCallStepId, summary, remainingWork}; any multi-call response containing compact_context, an empty/whitespace/missing summary executes nothing, returns error tool_results, counts every call against maxToolCalls and re-invokes the model within budgets; a disabled tool still ends in chat.error.

includes: server/tools/compact-context.ts ToolExecutor, registered after web-search and curl and before McpBridge construction, in both server/index.ts and the ws-handler constructor
server/ws-handler.ts: interception, sole-call rule, explicit per-call error tool_results, explicit toolCallCount increments for rejected calls, chat.done.compaction
server/types.ts and src/types/chat.ts: chat.done optional compaction field; backend-client carries the payload through to the client callbacks

stories.notes: Depends on: S4 (applyContextPlacement and per-invocation loop structure it extends). Primary owning_module is tool-loop (server/ws-handler.ts: interception, sole-call rule and budget accounting are the bulk of the work; AC-STRUCT-5 monotonic toolCallCount lives here); the compact-context-tool executor file is a small registration deliverable of the same story. Creates seam S-COMPACTION-WIRE consumed by S6. The server MUST NOT call the model again after a valid sole compact_context.

stories.name: fork-and-auto-continue
stories.title: Fork and Auto-Continue
stories.description: Client-side fork on a chat.done carrying compaction: the original's steps are applied first, then a new conversation titled '<original title> (compacted)' with titleEdited true, inheriting settings/tools, forkedFrom link, the original's system steps and one compaction step is created, selected, and its first request is sent automatically without compact_context and with a fresh budget. Adds the compaction step kind (types both sides, STEP_KINDS), its card and back-link, the sidebar visibility extension, transcript turn-boundary handling, and protection of the fork's streaming state from the original's finally cleanup.

includes: src/lib/use-chat-generation.ts and src/lib/use-conversations.ts: fork creation, selection, auto-send, stop/supersession guard, visibility predicate user-or-compaction
src/types/chat.ts Conversation.forkedFrom; StepKind 'compaction' on server/types.ts, src/types/chat.ts and server/request-validation.ts STEP_KINDS
src/lib/transcript.ts: compaction as visible turn boundary (findResponseStartIndex, deleteLastExchangeCutIndex)
src/components/transcript-step.tsx, step-card.tsx: compaction card and back-link
compaction step mapping verified through shared/ollama-format.ts and shared/openai-format.ts and server provider messages
excludes: automatic or user-triggered compaction, forward links, in-place compaction (out of scope)

stories.notes: Depends on: S3 (summary placement data), S5 (chat.done.compaction payload; S4 transitively). Consumes seam S-COMPACTION-WIRE. Owns AC-STRUCT-1 (the 'compaction' kind and chat.done.compaction field complete only when S5 and S6 have both landed; S5 adds the chat.done field, S6 adds the kind) and AC-STRUCT-3 (final release-gate pass; every story must individually keep lint and unit suites green). transport-client work (backend-client carrying the payload to the fork flow, in-flight guard) is delivered here and in S5; it has no separate owner.

stories.name: compaction-harness-event
stories.title: Compaction Harness Event
stories.description: Replace the compaction tool_result with a client-side harness event. On a valid sole compact_context the server sends chat.done with the authentic tool_call only (no tool_result). When the client creates the fork it appends one harness step to the original (kind meta, metaEvent.kind compaction, data.forkConversationId) rendered as an event card linking to the fork. placeStepsForModel omits unanswered compact_context tool_calls and that harness step from every wire request, so continuing the original stays valid on strict OpenAI-compatible providers. Also removes auto-continue: the fork is created and selected but nothing is sent until the user writes in it; the first user send carries [system, compaction, user] collated into one user-role wire message; the original settles normally.

includes: server/ws-handler.ts: sole valid compact_context ends with chat.done carrying the tool_call only (no tool_result); drop COMPACT_CONTEXT_ACK if unused
src/types/chat.ts + server/types.ts: MetaEventKind compaction
src/lib/fork.ts / use-chat-generation.ts / use-conversations.ts: append the harness meta step to the original when the fork is created (after the original chat.done steps)
shared/context-usage.ts placeStepsForModel: drop unanswered compact_context tool_calls and the compaction harness step
transcript rendering: harness event card with link to the fork (selects it), plain text when the fork is gone
update existing tests that assert the old tool_result (S5 tests, AC-STRUCT-5 property oracle, S6 fork tests)
use-chat-generation.ts: remove the fork auto-send, the withoutCompactContext/captured contextRequest path and the handoff settledCount bump; the original settles in its own finally

excludes: changes to the fork contents or auto-send (S6)
